name: Cleyera Rose
source:
The leader of a unit sent by a government agency to put an end to the school hijacking.

Her parents are American citizens who naturalized in Japan, so she has Japanese nationality.

Due to an incident that occurred during her childhood, she has an extraordinary hatred for criminals.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc032/character/cleyera.html]official site[/url]]
